- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment spikes) — reduce forecast by 5–10% when sentiment > 0.10.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment periods (negative sentiment) — add 5–10% to forecast when sentiment < -0.20.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak of prior 3-day window if sentiment is neutral or mildly bearish.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is > 15% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5–8% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Lagged overreaction: if forecast is > 10% above true outcome from 3–5 days prior, adjust downward by 3–5% to avoid momentum bias.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, reduce forecast by 2–4% if sentiment is consistently negative over last 7 days.
